correctness.rationale: For all strictly positive finite P, the stationary Poisson equation has a centered solution and the covariance sum equals the positive stationary conditional martingale variance. Analytic Perron perturbation identifies log-lambda derivatives -mean and Green-Kubo variance. Uniform Hilbert contraction plus Lipschitz moving Perron eigendistributions yields summably small log-normalizer differences O(k^(-2gamma-1)), so the survival-to-Perron-product ratio converges to a strictly positive constant. Taylor remainders O(k^(-3gamma)) are summable exactly for gamma>1/3. Harmonic-sum asymptotics and the explicit binary eigenfunction yield the claimed threshold and all positive exponents.
